property_summary: For any fuzzed re-entry depth n>=1, a call to airDrop from a counterparty that re-enters airDrop inside the supportsToken modifier always leaves exactly one 20-token grant (tokenBalance == 20); the mutant without '_locked = true' accepts the re-entrant calls, leaving tokenBalance == 20 + 20*n > 20.

Because _locked is set before airDrop's body/modifiers run, a re-entrant airDrop call made from the token-verify counterparty during the supportsToken check always reverts, so any caller's final tokenBalance is exactly 20; the mutant never sets _locked, so the re-entrant calls succeed and the balance exceeds 20.
